title: simbasjungles/free-my-tv
why_read: Similar Google TV debloating tool to the other listed project, overlapping functionality with less differentiation.
analysis: This is another ad-free home screen replacement for Google TV, notably built with Claude Code as a development tool, offering a simple undo mechanism. It covers the same niche as the other debloating tool in this list, so its main differentiator is development approach and smaller feature set. Functionally useful for end users but not a technically novel contribution.
